item.description:
• An Album Artist field on the main screen and in Edit Metadata…. Media servers such as Symphonia list an album under every name in its album artist (an album by "Nine Inch Nails, Boys Noize" appears under both) and look for the artist's photo in the album artist's folder, so the two can now differ: a classical album filed under its composer, or a collaboration filed under one band. On the main screen it's optional: left empty, the Artist is used, as before; filled in, it's written to every track and names the artist folder. In the editor, changing the Artist still changes the Album Artist on files where the two were the same.
  • Find Artist Logos finds artists with accented names, such as Björk. Online searches for an accented name, whether for an artist or an album, no longer come back empty.

Also new in 0.8.1:

  • A logo and a photo. Find Artist Logos can save a logo and a photo for the same artist: pick one of each, and a new column beside the artist's name shows what will be saved. Artists that already have a photo are offered photos again too, so you can switch between Logo and Photo for them.
  • Find Artist Logos no longer fails to replace or remove an image on a drive without a Trash, such as a network share. The old file is deleted instead, as Finder does.

Also new in 0.8:

  • Find Artist Logos. Tools ▸ Find Artist Logos… (⇧⌘F) looks through your music library for artist folders without a logo, finds each artist's logos and photos on fanart.tv, and lets you pick a logo, a photo, or one of each. Logos are saved as logo.png and photos as artist.jpg in the artist's folder, the one that holds their album folders. Symphonia shows them for each artist: Odeion puts the logo in its Artists list and the photo on the artist's page. Needs a Look lists the artists still to do; All lists every artist, and Find Another replaces an image you already have (the old file goes to the Trash, or is deleted on a drive without one). Add your own free fanart.tv personal key in Settings ▸ Metadata for faster access to newly added images.
  • Use the artwork already in the album folder. When you rip the second disc of a set into the same folder, The Splitter finds the first disc's cover.jpg and offers to use it, with a full-size preview. Artwork used this way is kept as it is. If you encode over existing artwork anyway, you can now keep it, not only replace it or cancel.
  • A Composer field on the main screen and in Edit Metadata…. On the main screen it's written to every track; in the editor it changes or clears the composer of the selected files.
  • Search for Artwork… no longer sometimes lists the same image twice when two releases share it.

Artist logos and photos come from fanart.tv, where its community adds them. This beta works through December 31, 2026. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26.5 or later.
